opening.argument: The video presents a specific RBC client relief program for people facing lost jobs or income, with concrete forms of assistance rather than a demand for payment. It describes deferrals on mortgages, loans, and credit card balances, alongside possible reductions in credit card interest charges, refinancing, and credit restructuring. The closing direction to an RBC COVID-19 webpage is framed as a way to learn more about the program. Taken together, those details support an informational account of ordinary financial services for clients experiencing hardship. The material does not describe a payment or credential request, nor does it establish that any particular client will receive relief.

citations.quote: Through payment deferrals you can defer payments on mortgages, loans, and credit card balances with no impact on your credit score.

We're also offering hardship relief for personal and business clients who are struggling due to lost jobs or income, which may include help with reducing credit card interest charges, refinancing, and credit restructuring.
Everything you need to know about the RBC Client Relief Program can be found at rbc.com slash COVID19
